description: This is a Perl script for managing configuration files, including loading, comparing, and manipulating configuration data with functions like set_config, load_config, config_and, config_add, config_diff, config_sub, and parse_expr. It processes configuration files with a specific prefix 'CONFIG_' and outputs configuration lines.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sets a configuration value based on conditions.

methods.name: load_config
methods.description: Loads configuration from a file, parsing lines with a specific prefix.

methods.name: config_and
methods.description: Computes the intersection of two configuration hashes.

methods.name: config_add
methods.description: Merges two configuration hashes with optional modifications.

methods.name: config_diff
methods.description: Finds differences between two configuration hashes.

methods.name: config_sub
methods.description: Subtracts one configuration hash from another.

methods.name: parse_expr
methods.description: Parses configuration expressions for logical operations.
